plan.title: Scholarship Application Overview
plan.subtitle: Summary of applicant demographics, approval status, and scheme distribution

panels.title: Approved applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Approved'

panels.title: Disbursed applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Disbursed'

panels.title: Pending applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending'

panels.title: Applications by Category
panels.sql: SELECT "Category", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Applications by Scheme
panels.sql: SELECT "Name of scheme", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 10 Villages by Applications
panels.sql: SELECT "Gaon", COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The board received a total of {{p1}} scholarship applications. Out of these, {{p2}} were approved, {{p3}} have been disbursed, and {{p4}} remain pending. The majority of applicants fall under the {{p5.0}} category, followed by {{p5.1}}. Applications are distributed across various schemes, with the highest volume for {{p6.0}}. The village with the most applications is {{p7.0}}.
